mapper.select: SELECT id, expense_code, initiation_id, employee_id, employee_name, expense_type, amount, expense_date, description, receipt_url, status, approver_id, approver_name, approved_at, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_cost_expense WHERE expense_code = #{code} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE pmis_cost_expense SET status = #{status}, approver_id = COALESCE(#{approverId}, approver_id), approver_name = COALESCE(#{approverName}, approver_name), approved_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'APPROVED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE approved_at END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM pmis_cost_expense WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM pmis_cost_expense WHERE initiation_id = #{initiationId} AND deleted = 0 AND status IN ('SUBMITTED','APPROVED','PAID')
